properties.displayName: PHI bulk download from unfamiliar network
properties.description:
#INC_CORR#
Alerts when a user downloads 50+ distinct files from PHI SharePoint/OneDrive locations from IPs absent from their 14-day sign-in history. High: no history or new country. Medium: new IP in a known country.
properties.query:
// Secure Scale Systems | PHI bulk download from an unfamiliar network
// Sentinel scheduled rule: run every 1h | query period 14d | alert when results > 0
// Dynamic severity: Severity column | Entities: Account = UserId, IP = IPAddress
// MITRE ATT&CK: T1530 Data from Cloud Storage, T1213.002 SharePoint (Collection)
// NIST CSF 2.0: DE.CM-03, DE.AE-02, DE.AE-03 | HIPAA: 164.312(b), 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D)
let DetectionWindow = 1h;      // records that ARRIVED in the last hour; matches rule frequency, so each record is evaluated once
let MaxArrivalDelay = 1d;      // OfficeActivity records can arrive hours late (11h observed); events older than this are ignored
let BaselinePeriod  = 14d;     // must not exceed the rule query period
let BaselineGap     = 1d;      // baseline ends 1 day back (>= MaxArrivalDelay), so an attacker's recent sign-ins never count as familiar
let FileThreshold   = 50;      // distinct PHI files from unfamiliar IPs per user per window
let ExcludedAccounts = dynamic([]);   // approved bulk-download service accounts (backup, migration, eDiscovery)
// Primary scope: SharePoint/OneDrive sites known to hold PHI (Sentinel watchlist, SearchKey = site URL)
let SensitiveSites = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('PHI-Sensitive-Sites')
    | summarize make_set(tolower(trim_end(@"/", tostring(SearchKey)))));
// Fallback scope: PHI naming in site or library paths, matched on word boundaries
let SensitivePathRegex = @"(?i)(^|[^a-z])(patients?|phi|ehr|emr|clinical|medical[ _-]?records?)([^a-z]|$)";
// 1. PHI downloads that arrived in the detection window (ingestion time, so late records are never skipped)
let PHIDownloads = OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(MaxArrivalDelay)
    | where coalesce(ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated) > ago(DetectionWindow)   // coalesce: test fixtures have no ingestion time
    | where OfficeWorkload in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive")
    | where Operation in ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull")
    | where UserId has "@" and not(UserId in~ (ExcludedAccounts))
    | where tolower(trim_end(@"/", Site_Url)) in (SensitiveSites)
        or strcat(Site_Url, SourceRelativeUrl) matches regex SensitivePathRegex
    | extend UserKey = tolower(UserId);
// 2. Users over the threshold on raw volume (cheap pre-filter before the baseline lookup)
let CandidateUsers = toscalar(
    PHIDownloads
    | summarize Files = dcount(OfficeObjectId) by UserKey
    | where Files >= FileThreshold
    | summarize make_set(UserKey));
// 3. Familiar networks: successful interactive and non-interactive sign-ins, ending BaselineGap before now
let Baseline = union SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(BaselinePeriod) .. ago(BaselineGap))
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | extend UserKey = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
    | where UserKey in (CandidateUsers)
    | summarize by UserKey, IPAddress
    | extend Country = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(IPAddress).country)
    | summarize KnownIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10000), KnownCountries = make_set(Country, 200) by UserKey;
// 4. Keep only downloads from IPs the user has never signed in from, then re-apply the threshold
PHIDownloads
| where UserKey in (CandidateUsers)
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on UserKey
| extend DownloadCountry = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(ClientIP).country)
| extend IPKnown      = iff(array_length(KnownIPs) > 0, set_has_element(KnownIPs, ClientIP), false)
| extend CountryKnown = iff(array_length(KnownCountries) > 0, set_has_element(KnownCountries, DownloadCountry), false)
| where not(IPKnown)
| summarize
    StartTime        = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime          = max(TimeGenerated),
    UnfamiliarFiles  = dcount(OfficeObjectId),
    DownloadEvents   = count(),
    NewCountryEvents = countif(not(CountryKnown)),
    UnfamiliarIPs    = make_set(ClientIP, 20),
    Countries        = make_set(DownloadCountry, 20),
    Sites            = make_set(Site_Url, 20),
    SampleFiles      = make_set(SourceFileName, 25),
    UserAgents       = make_set(UserAgent, 10),
    BaselineIPCount  = take_any(array_length(KnownIPs)),
    UserId           = take_any(UserId)
    by UserKey
| where UnfamiliarFiles >= FileThreshold
| extend BaselineIPCount = coalesce(BaselineIPCount, 0)
// High: no sign-in history at all, or downloads from a country never seen for this user
| extend Severity  = iff(BaselineIPCount == 0 or NewCountryEvents > 0, "High", "Medium")
| extend IPAddress = tostring(UnfamiliarIPs[0])
| project StartTime, EndTime, UserId, Severity, UnfamiliarFiles, DownloadEvents, IPAddress,
          UnfamiliarIPs, Countries, NewCountryEvents, BaselineIPCount, Sites, SampleFiles, UserAgents
| order by UnfamiliarFiles desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: PHI bulk download by {{UserId}} from unfamiliar network
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{UserId}} downloaded {{UnfamiliarFiles}} PHI files from unfamiliar IP {{IPAddress}}
